'''Semako Thalien''' was a business magnate who lived during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture. Thalien and a number of other wealthy businesspeople were aboard a [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] [[Unidentified refugee transport|transport]] fleeing raiders when they crash-landed on the previously undiscovered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Makeb]]. Thalien assumed a leadership role among the survivors as they established settlements and made contact with the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], leading them in developing a thriving economy based on Makeb's rich [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits within the next fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="History of Makeb">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|History of Makeb}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Semako Thalien was first mentioned in the Codex entry "History of Makeb" in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the [[2013]] digital expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="History of Makeb" /> Semako shares a surname with another character from the Mandalorian Wars, [[Jervo Thalien]], who was created by [[John Jackson Miller]] for the [[2006]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']],<ref name="KOTOR">[[Knights of the Old Republic 1|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 1]]</ref> but no relation between the two was ever established.<ref name="History of Makeb" />
